verify.note: The default runs no hook (no clash to remove; Sinclair's ROM as the whole alt ROM), so it is proved by the boot check and the ROM paths; the replay proves Enhanced: at every hook every register with R, all 48K RAM but the dead stack, MMU and clock against the original; at every copy in play the canvas and the published window against an independent plane model; ABI cases on two states a site and 10 broken builds on a1 to frame 700. Levels 1, 2, 3, 5, 13, 17, 19 were replayed from test pokes in the review run (games/gunrunner.md "Evidence"), not here.
